parent_decision.result: Phi-3 qualifies 13/14 capabilities; grammar alone fails.

hypothesis: A distinct larger source can supply the single missing grammar inventory while Phi-3 supplies only its 13 separately qualified inventories, demonstrating ABI's intended per-capability multi-source assembly rather than forcing one teacher to provide every capability.
decision_rule: Run exactly one targeted 224-prompt Qwen2-7B grammar survey on the unchanged V3 prompts and deterministic prompt-bound evaluator.
The previously observed one-row V61 grammar failure remains disclosed and is not excluded from the full survey.
Reject this source if runtime accounting, EOS, search depth, validation pass rate, or Wilson lower bound fails.
Do not change prompts, evaluator, source, precision, or thresholds after the result.
If grammar qualifies, construct a new multi-source survey lineage that exposes Phi-3's 13 qualified entries and Qwen2-7B's grammar entry, then compose all 14 with source_policy best_evidence.
Do not invoke LayerCake until the resulting multi-source composition passes segregation and adequacy.
failure_attribution: A V65 failure is ABI_REFERENCE_SOURCE_CAPABILITY_GAP, never a LayerCake failure.
